# Bill Gates won LinkedIn with the strongest personal branding play. | Marie Olivie · LinkedIn · 2026-01-15

...

Bill Gates won LinkedIn with the strongest personal branding play.

...

(and it wasn’t designed by a growth team)

Bill Gates has the highest number of followers (39,705,854) on LinkedIn.

The number of follower count is more than:
– LinkedIn’s own founders
– Its current CEO
– Almost every Fortune 500 leader

...

And the interesting part is he doesn’t use LinkedIn like a powerful person.

...

Instead, his profile is pure personal brand.

...

What Bill Gates does differently than others and the reason why his profile matters for anyone building a Personal Brand:
👉 Posts like a curious human, not a billionaire
👉 Shares what he’s learning like a curious reader
👉 Writes about his personal experiences

...

👉 Talks about books, climate, health, failure.
👉 Never positions himself as “the smartest person in the room”

# Get Profile

...

...

Fetch a member's public LinkedIn profile by their vanity `public_id` (the
`/in/` segment of the URL, e.g. `williamhgates`).

...

This is the logged-out JSON-LD subset LinkedIn exposes to signed-out
visitors — not the full logged-in record. There is no contact info, no
connection graph, and no full skills list. Experience and education are the
coarse entries LinkedIn renders publicly.

...

# LinkedIn Profile Data API - Fetch Any LinkedIn Profile

...

The Fetch Profile endpoint creates an async task to retrieve full LinkedIn profile data for any public profile. You provide a profile slug (the part after `linkedin.com/in/`) and receive a task ID to poll for results.

...

## Request Body

...

The LinkedIn profile slug (e.g., `"williamhgates"` from `linkedin.com/in/williamhgates`)

...

The `profile_slug` is the last part of a LinkedIn profile URL. For `https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates`, the slug is `williamhgates`.

...

}

## What data does the profile response include?

...

The profile data typically includes: name, headline, location, profile URL, number of connections and followers, about/summary, work experience, education, and skills. The exact fields depend on what the LinkedIn profile has publicly available.
